goal: 让 3rd-review provider 逻辑运行有一个共享的有限最终期限，并确保超时后的 provider 进程最终结束。
non_goals: 不改 WorkflowHub 外层调用、health-runner、config、protocol、provider adapter、重试策略或公共流程
不把 provider unavailable 改成 findings/pass
stop_conditions: 需要新增公开配置/字段、第二状态机、WorkflowHub 外层 timeout、provider adapter 或修改 workflowhub-result.v3
expected_handoff: Broker 在一次 provider 逻辑运行中只计算一次绝对 deadline；所有已有 attempt/retry/repair/rewrite 只消费剩余时间；超时沿用 PROCESS_TIMEOUT，忽略 SIGTERM 的进程在现有宽限期后被终止。

red.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='timeout eventually kills|provider terminal recovery consumes' test/process.test.mjs test/broker.test.mjs
red.result: 两项红测失败：timeout eventually kills provider that ignores SIGTERM 收到 PROCESS_TIMEOUT 后进程仍存活；provider terminal recovery consumes one shared deadline 的 recovery attempt 仍获得完整新期限（约 131ms），说明当前 process cleanup 会清掉 SIGKILL 计时器且 Broker 每个 attempt 重新计时。
limits: 红测使用本地 test fixtures，不证明真实 provider 或网络质量

green.result: 56 tests passed; 覆盖初始执行、共享 deadline、默认期限常量、终止宽限期、忽略 SIGTERM 的主进程和主进程退出后的 descendant。

review.source: independent read-only review of the four changed 3rd-review files

findings.fact: timeout now starts a referenced grace timer, launches providers in a separate process group, and force-kills the group after SIGTERM; regression covers a leader that exits while its descendant ignores SIGTERM
Broker skips any retry, same-session repair, or output rewrite once the shared deadline is exhausted instead of spawning a 1ms attempt

findings.reason: D-017 and DEC-005 explicitly choose one finite internal final deadline for every provider; health probes remain advisory and may finish earlier
The approved non-goal forbids changing workflowhub-result.v3; the internal safety bound is intentionally not presented as a new public protocol field
